fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)

properties_axi_baseline_inherited.english_form: When VALID is asserted, it must remain asserted until the handshake occurs (rising clock edge with VALID and READY both HIGH). Applies to AW/W/B/AR/R and to AC/CR/CD.
properties_axi_baseline_inherited.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (CRVALID && !CRREADY) |=> CRVALID);

properties_axi_baseline_inherited.english_form: VALID must not be combinationally dependent on READY. A source is not permitted to wait until READY before asserting VALID. Applies to AC/CR/CD as well.
properties_axi_baseline_inherited.sva_form: // Structural — checked by lint / interface review.

properties_axi_baseline_inherited.english_form: A burst must not cross a 4KB address boundary.
properties_axi_baseline_inherited.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (ARVALID && ARREADY) |-> ((ARADDR[11:0] + ((ARLEN+1) << ARSIZE)) <= 13'h1000));

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: ARDOMAIN/AWDOMAIN must be one of 0b00 Non-shareable, 0b01 Inner Shareable, 0b10 Outer Shareable, 0b11 System.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) ARVALID |-> (ARDOMAIN inside {2'b00,2'b01,2'b10,2'b11}));

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: ARSNOOP encoding must match the permitted combinations of ARBAR[0] and ARDOMAIN per Table C3-7. Reserved encodings must not be used.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: // Scoreboard: enumerate permitted ARSNOOP/ARDOMAIN/ARBAR tuples and reject the rest.

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: AWSNOOP encoding must match the permitted combinations of AWBAR[0] and AWDOMAIN per Table C3-8. Reserved encodings must not be used.
RRESP[3:2] (IsShared, PassDirty) must be constant for all data transfers within a single read burst.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (RVALID && RREADY && !RLAST) |=> (RRESP[3:2] == $past(RRESP[3:2])));

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: RRESP[3:2] must be 0 for ReadNoSnoop, Barrier, and DVM transactions.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: // Per-transaction: track ARSNOOP and constrain RRESP[3:2] = 0 for ReadNoSnoop/Barrier/DVM.

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: CRRESP[3] IsShared must be LOW for ReadUnique, CleanInvalid, and MakeInvalid snoop transactions.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (CRVALID && CRREADY && (ACSNOOP inside {4'b0111,4'b1001,4'b1101})) |-> (CRRESP[3] == 1'b0));

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: If CRRESP[2] PassDirty = 1, then CRRESP[0] DataTransfer must also be 1 (data must be transferred when responsibility is passed).
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (CRVALID && CRREADY && CRRESP[2]) |-> CRRESP[0]);

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: The cached master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CRVALID.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) $rose(CRVALID) |-> $past(ACVALID && ACREADY,1));

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: The cached master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CDVALID.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) $rose(CDVALID) |-> $past(ACVALID && ACREADY,1));

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: All snoop transactions are ordered. A response on CR must be in the same order as the addresses presented on AC.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: // Scoreboard: per-master FIFO of (AC handshake -> CR handshake) ordering.

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: RACK is a single-cycle pulse asserted on the rising ACLK edge that follows the rising ACLK edge on which RLAST AND RVALID AND RREADY are all observed HIGH.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (RVALID && RREADY && RLAST) |=> RACK ##1 !RACK);

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: WACK is a single-cycle pulse asserted on the rising ACLK edge that follows the rising ACLK edge on which BVALID AND BREADY are both observed HIGH.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (BVALID && BREADY) |=> WACK ##1 !WACK);

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: Cache line transitions must follow Table C5-4. Permitted end states depend on initial state and snoop transaction. PassDirty must be asserted for Dirty->Clean and Dirty->Invalid (except MakeInvalid).
CD burst length must be 1, 2, 4, 8, or 16; full cache-line transactions must use full CDDATA bus width.
WriteEvict (AWSNOOP=0b101) requires the AWUNIQUE signal to be implemented. Without AWUNIQUE, WriteEvict is not supported.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: // Structural: presence of AWUNIQUE port checked at integration.

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: ACE-Lite masters must not implement AC/CR/CD channels. They may only issue ReadOnce, ReadNoSnoop, WriteUnique, WriteLineUnique, WriteNoSnoop, and barriers.
properties_ace_extensions.sva_form: // Structural: master port introspection at integration.

properties_ace_extensions.english_form: A DVMComplete (ARSNOOP=0b1110) must be issued after all DVMMessage targets have responded; it serves as the aggregated completion notification.

evidence.spec_section: C3.1.1 Shareability domain types / Table C3-2
evidence.quote: AxDOMAIN[1:0]: 0b00 Non-shareable, 0b01 Inner Shareable, 0b10 Outer Shareable, 0b11 System.
Permitted read address control signal combinations with ARBAR[0]=0 and ARDOMAIN/ARSNOOP enumerated.
Permitted write address control signal combinations with AWBAR[0]=0 and AWDOMAIN/AWSNOOP enumerated.
The IsShared and PassDirty responses must be constant for all data transfers within a burst. The IsShared and PassDirty response must be LOW for ReadNoSnoop, Barrier transactions, DVM transactions.
When the CRVALID signal is asserted the snoop response on CRRESP must not change until the interconnect sets CRREADY HIGH. When CRVALID is asserted, it must remain asserted until CRREADY is asserted.
The following responses are illegal: IsShared, CRRESP[3] = 1 for ReadUnique, CleanInvalid, MakeInvalid. PassDirty, CRRESP[2] = 1, and DataTransfer, CRRESP[0] = 0, for any transaction.
All cache line size transactions must be a full data bus width. The burst length must be 1, 2, 4, 8, or 16.
The master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CRVALID. The master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CDVALID.
If the cache line moves from a Dirty state to a Clean state, the PassDirty snoop response bit must be asserted.
